method.name: renderTerminalStyle
method.purpose: The canonical, pure token-to-CSS renderer that turns a TerminalTheme into an inlined style-element string. Named on sc1 because it is consumed ACROSS the boundary by S003 (webview bootstrap) so the terminal look is produced in exactly one place; without it sc1's 'single source every surface consumes' guarantee would rely on each surface re-deriving the CSS mapping.

rationale: The HLD sc1 interfaceSketch is type-only (TerminalTheme + SurfaceKind); designing the contract showed sc1 needs one canonical renderer method so downstream surfaces consume produced CSS rather than re-mapping tokens. This is a single additive method on the one contract s1 already owns (well under 30% of contracts touched, additive, non-breaking) -- an amendment, not a rework.
